roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.short_description: Extracts insights from structured data, creates business dashboards, and informs strategic decisions through statistical exploration.
roles.overview: Data Analysts bridge business and technology by collecting, cleaning, and modeling data. Key competencies include SQL querying, business intelligence dashboarding, statistical reasoning, and data storytelling.

example_projects.title: E-Commerce Customer Retention & Churn Dashboard
example_projects.description: Analyze transaction logs using SQL, calculate cohort retention, and build an interactive Power BI dashboard tracking monthly churn and CLV.

example_projects.title: Sales Performance & Regional Inventory Analysis
example_projects.description: Perform exploratory data analysis on sales trends across regions using Python (Pandas) and generate automated executive summary charts.

example_projects.title: Healthcare Clinic Appointment No-Show Statistical Analysis
example_projects.description: Use hypothesis testing and regression in Python or Excel to uncover key drivers of patient no-shows and propose operational adjustments.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.short_description: Designs, writes, tests, and maintains modern web and enterprise software applications across frontend and backend systems.
roles.overview: Software Developers turn user requirements into robust application logic. They write modular code, implement RESTful backend services, build responsive web interfaces, and collaborate using version control.

example_projects.title: Full-Stack Task & Project Management System
example_projects.description: Create a collaborative Kanban board application with React frontend, FastAPI/Django backend, and relational database persistence.

example_projects.title: RESTful E-Commerce Product Catalog & Cart API
example_projects.description: Develop a high-performance backend API with JWT authentication, CRUD endpoints, filtering, and automated unit tests.

example_projects.title: Responsive Developer Portfolio & Blog Platform
example_projects.description: Build a modern, accessible web application featuring dynamic markdown rendering, responsive layouts, and clean CSS styling.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.short_description: Builds statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and predictive systems to solve complex business challenges.
roles.overview: Data Scientists combine advanced mathematics, computer science, and business intuition. They preprocess complex datasets, engineer predictive features, train ML models, and validate experimental hypotheses.

example_projects.title: Predictive Loan Default Risk Classifier
example_projects.description: Develop a binary classification pipeline using scikit-learn to forecast credit defaults, handling class imbalance and interpreting feature importances.

example_projects.title: Customer Segmentation via Unsupervised Clustering
example_projects.description: Cluster customer purchasing patterns using K-Means and PCA, visualizing behavioral clusters to inform personalized marketing campaigns.

example_projects.title: End-to-End ML Microservice Deployment
example_projects.description: Wrap a trained regression model with a FastAPI inference endpoint, including input validation and automated schema documentation.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer (SDE)
roles.short_description: Engineers scalable distributed systems, algorithms, performant backend architectures, and core software platforms.
roles.overview: Software Development Engineers specialize in algorithmic problem-solving, system design, scalability, and robust engineering practices. They write high-efficiency code in compiled or modern runtime environments.

example_projects.title: Distributed In-Memory Key-Value Store with LRU Cache
example_projects.description: Implement a multithreaded caching service with concurrency locks, time-to-live expiration, and custom serialization in Java or C++.

example_projects.title: Scalable URL Shortener with Analytics & Rate Limiting
example_projects.description: Design a high-throughput URL shortening service using token-bucket rate limiting, relational database indexing, and REST APIs.

example_projects.title: Graph Algorithm Visualizer & Pathfinding Simulator
example_projects.description: Implement Dijkstra's, A*, and topological sort algorithms with interactive step-by-step state visualization.
